events.text:
Possível obstáculo observado

Observação: Using only Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, and typing, I selected Atlas (12 seats, projector, $280 all-in), entered 'Quarterly planning', and reached the Review page where all details matched. On Review, Tab cycled through the logo, 'Our spaces', 'My reservations', 'Choose another room', and 'Edit meeting name', then moved to a step with no visible focus before wrapping to the logo; 'Confirm reservation' never received a visible focus outline in forward or reverse Tab, and Enter/Space at the unoutlined step did not confirm.

Interpretação simulada: The flow up to review is keyboard-operable and Atlas meets all meeting constraints, but the final 'Confirm reservation' control appears to be missing from the keyboard Tab order, blocking a keyboard-only user at the last step.

Limites: No confirmed reservation was produced, so final confirmation content was not verified. Whether 'Confirm reservation' works with a pointer, or is focusable through another keyboard method not tested here, is unknown. The unoutlined step after 'Edit meeting name' might be browser-level focus rather than a page control; this is inferred from Space scrolling the page in screenshot 56.

Capturas indicadas: #16, #34, #44, #46, #48, #50, #52, #54, #56. A correspondência com a evidência requer revisão humana.
events.interpretation: Relato do modelo; capturas e conclusões exigem revisão humana.

findings.title: 'Confirm reservation' is not reached by Tab or Shift+Tab on the Review page
findings.observation: On the Review page, Tab moved visibly from 'Choose another room' (42) to 'Edit meeting name' (44), then to a step with no visible focus on any control (46 and again 52), then wrapped to the Gather logo (48). Shift+Tab from the logo returned to 'Edit meeting name' rather than 'Confirm reservation' (50). Pressing Enter at the unoutlined step left the review page unchanged (54), and Space scrolled the page instead of activating a button (56), indicating focus was not on 'Confirm reservation'.
findings.expected: The visible 'Confirm reservation' control should receive keyboard focus in the Tab order and activate with Enter or Space, like 'Choose Atlas' and 'Review booking' did earlier.
findings.expectedSource: Saved charter and persona declared expectation: required booking controls should receive keyboard focus and activate with standard keys; keyboard-only completion is the success criterion.
findings.personaComment: I got all the way to the final review, but I could not see or reach 'Confirm reservation' with my keyboard.
findings.interpretation: For a keyboard-only user this appears to block independent completion at the final step, even though the meeting, room, and price all match the requirements.
findings.uncertainty: I did not use a pointer to test whether the button works with a mouse; the finding is limited to keyboard reachability and visible focus in this session. Focus leaving the page content after 'Edit meeting name' is inferred from the lack of outline and Space scrolling behavior.

findings.title: Room choice, meeting-name entry, and review navigation worked by keyboard
findings.observation: Earlier steps were keyboard-operable with clear focus outlines: 'Choose Atlas' was focused and activated with Enter (16), the Meeting name field received focus and accepted 'Quarterly planning' (28, 30), and 'Review booking' received focus and advanced to review (32, 34).
findings.expected: Earlier booking controls should also be keyboard-operable, so the barrier can be localized.
findings.expectedSource: Inferred expectation from the charter that room selection and forms should be keyboard-operable; earlier visible focus outlines established the pattern to compare against.
findings.personaComment: Choosing the room and entering my meeting name worked fine by keyboard; only the last confirm step stopped me.
findings.interpretation: The keyboard barrier in this run is specific to the final confirmation step rather than the whole booking flow.
findings.uncertainty: This covers only the controls I used on the landing, details, and review-entry steps; other rooms and controls were not tested.

persona.name: Casey · Keyboard access
persona.description: A fictional Home v3 persona who needs to complete the booking using only the keyboard.
persona.label: Casey · Keyboard access
persona.context: You are arranging the team’s quarterly planning meeting and rely on keyboard navigation. You need to reach and operate each required control without using a mouse or touch.
persona.mission: Book a room for 12 people with a projector for the available one-hour meeting slot. Enter the meeting purpose Quarterly planning. Keep the complete cost at or below $350.
persona.initialKnowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know the meeting requirements, but have no walkthrough, knowledge of its rooms or prices, or prior reservation.
persona.knowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know the meeting requirements, but have no walkthrough, knowledge of its rooms or prices, or prior reservation.
persona.constraints: You need seats for all 12 people and a projector. The complete cost, including any fees and equipment, must not exceed $350. Use only the fictional meeting details. Use keyboard navigation and typing only. Do not click coordinates or controls, use touch, select an option through a pointer shortcut, or bypass the visible interface. Type only after establishing keyboard focus.
persona.skills: Experienced with Tab navigation, visible focus, Enter and Space activation, arrow keys where supported, and typing into the focused form field.
persona.decision: Follow the visible focus through the booking flow and use keyboard activation for controls. If a required control appears unreachable, attempt reasonable keyboard navigation and report the exact observed barrier without assuming a defect in advance.
persona.resources: A desktop browser and keyboard, with fictional meeting details. No mouse or touch input, real account, or payment information.
persona.expectations: Visible keyboard focus, a sensible focus order, keyboard-operable room selection and forms, and a readable reservation confirmation.
persona.priorities: Complete the reservation independently using the keyboard and identify any observed control that prevents that goal.
persona.successCriteria: Verify a visible confirmed reservation with the requested meeting purpose, 12 attendees, a projector, and an all-in total within $350. Report any missing or uncertain detail accurately. Reach this outcome through keyboard interaction alone.
persona.stopCriteria: Stop after a verified suitable reservation, a supported obstacle after reasonable recovery, an unsafe action, or the session limits. Do not book beyond your budget or claim success without visible evidence.

limitations: Synthetic persona observations. Completion is distinct from achieving the goal.
